name: Spinner
summary: Loading indicators: a spinner with its words read as a status, and decorative skeleton placeholders.
rungReason: No element says "loading": role="status" with visually hidden words announces it, and aria-busy on the region marks what's loading.

a11y.name: The spinner's words
a11y.description: Put aria-busy="true" on the region that's loading, and remove it when the content arrives

keyboard.action: Passes over it: it takes no focus

rules: Render the spinner when loading starts; a status announces changes, so one inserted already full may not be read in every screen reader
When the content arrives, focus stays where it was: don't move it to the new content
withoutJavaScript: There is no loading state without script
motion: The spinner turns 3× slower under reduced motion (it must keep saying "still working"); skeletons stop shimmering
forcedColors: A CanvasText arc on a GrayText ring; skeletons are outlined boxes
